Four separate Research Council Norway grant allocations imported. Ministry ice protection announcements may overlap a development contract. EDF EUR4m is consortium-wide.

Issuer and procurement sources corroborate UMO Ukraine 45274055. Product contracts and attendance at Brave1 forum are not attributable financing.

Issuer confirms majority accession to Quantum Systems, with no consideration or issuer proceeds disclosed. Parent Series D not attributed. Regional grant amount still requires original award source.

Issuer and charitable fund 45364185 are separate. Donations and military purchases do not establish financing for the commercial issuer.
